name: Choice Relay
description: Generate grounded action options, display them in an interactive SPFx component, and turn the user's selection into one next action.

conversation_starters.title: Help me choose what to do
conversation_starters.text: I have 30 minutes before my next meeting. Our pilot starts next week. The demo passed, but the data feed is a week late and the participant briefing still isn't written. What could I start now? I'd rather pick one myself before you tell me where to begin.

conversation_starters.title: Weigh up three options
conversation_starters.text: I could chase the late data feed, write the participant briefing, or rehearse the demo again. I haven't decided which one yet. Lay them out so I can choose.

conversation_starters.title: Start from a decision
conversation_starters.text: I've decided to write the participant briefing. Our pilot starts next week and I have half an hour. What is one small step I could finish in that time?
